name: linker-fake-load-unwrapper
description: Recovering Android AArch64 ELF files wrapped by a linker-style fake PT_LOAD: impossible high-address LOAD segments, entry-point translation, XOR runtime decryptors, carved embedded ELF stages and custom mmap/mprotect loaders — with both static and dynamic workflows to reach the real image. — 处理被 linker 风格假 PT_LOAD 包裹的 Android AArch64 ELF：虚高地址 LOAD 段、入口点偏移、XOR 运行期解密、内嵌 ELF 分阶段、自研 mmap/mprotect loader——提供静态与动态两条路走到真实镜像。
